item.title: Scott Dixon awarded prestigious New Zealand honor
item.description: To close out 2025, one of IndyCar’s most decorated drivers was awarded knighthood by his home country of New Zealand. Scott Dixon was given the title of Knight Companion of the New Zealand Order of Merit on December 31, making his new official title Sir Scott Dixon, KNZM.
